summary: Tested SC Type Selection and MO Auto-Complete features. All core features working correctly: (1) Create MO dialog shows SC Type radio (With Material/Without Material), (2) Backend stores subcontract_type in work_orders and subcontract_orders, (3) With Material flow consumes stock and creates DC, (4) Without Material flow skips stock consumption and DC creation, (5) MO auto-completes when SC receipt received.
passed_tests: POST /api/work-orders with subcontract_type='with_material' - stores type correctly
POST /api/work-orders with subcontract_type='without_material' - stores type correctly
POST /api/work-orders/{id}/start with 'with_material' - consumes stock, creates DC, creates SC order
POST /api/work-orders/{id}/start with 'without_material' - NO stock consumed, NO DC created, SC order has sent_quantity=0
POST /api/job-work/receipts - MO auto-completes when SC order becomes completed
MO auto-complete sets status='completed', all operations='completed', FG stock increased
subcontract_type field stored in work_orders collection
subcontract_type field stored in subcontract_orders collection
Frontend: Create MO dialog shows SC Type radio when SC checkbox checked
Frontend: Helper text changes based on SC type selection
